_pattern_notes.tables: Cohort tables: insightsprod.equipfoods_5642_prod_presentation.simplified_customer_cohorts_v2 (acq_month/month_diff grain). Ad spend for Marketing Channel views: insightsprod.equipfoods_5642_prod_presentation.AdvertisingMaster (ad_date/ad_channel/spend only). Discount code analysis only: insightsprod.equipfoods_5642_prod_presentation.LineItemMaster LEFT JOIN insightsprod.equipfoods_5642_prod_main.dim_orders on order_id AND effective_end_date IS NULL -- dim_orders is in the _prod_main dataset, not _prod_presentation.
_pattern_notes.date_range_syntax: Always >= start_date AND < end_date. Never BETWEEN, never <= end_date. No automatic default period — {date_from}/{date_to} must be supplied.
_pattern_notes.rounding: ROUND(..., 0) for monetary and count values (Total Revenue, CAC, LTV, Customers Acquired). ROUND(..., 2) for ratios and rates (Repurchase Rate %, LTV/CAC).
_pattern_notes.total_revenue_formula: SUM(item_gross_sales) - SUM(item_discount_total) - SUM(item_returns_total) + SUM(shipping_price_total) - SUM(shipping_tax_total), all COALESCE(...,0). Business Logic Section 2.1.
_pattern_notes.cac_formula: Total Ad Spend / Customers Acquired, both fixed at month_diff = 0 via a window function over the full cohort grain. Business Logic Section 2.2.
_pattern_notes.ltv_formula_by_acq_channel: RUNNING_SUM(Total Revenue - COALESCE(cogs, Total Revenue * (1 - CASE WHEN acq_channel='Shopify' THEN 0.55 WHEN acq_channel='Amazon Seller Central' THEN 0.495 END))) ordered by month_diff. Fixed % per channel is a fallback only, used when cogs IS NULL (rare -- 0% null verified across 24 months). Business Logic Section 2.4, EF-012.
_pattern_notes.marketing_channel_ltv_formula: (Total Revenue - COGS) for every Unified Marketing Channel; falls back to a flat 55% margin on Total Revenue only when cogs IS NULL for a row -- not the 55%/49.5% acq_channel split, since a marketing channel can span both Shopify- and Amazon-acquired customers. Business Logic Section 2.8, EF-012.
_pattern_notes.marketing_channel_join: AdvertisingMaster joined to simplified_customer_cohorts_v2 on ad_month = acq_month AND cleaned unified_marketing_channel. Only Google Ads, Facebook Ads, and Unattributed- Amazon carry real spend — every other channel (including TikTok, blocked for now by client instruction) shows CAC and LTV/CAC as '-', not NULL. Business Logic Section 2.8.
_pattern_notes.unified_marketing_channel_cleaning: CASE WHEN unified_marketing_channel = 'ChatGpt' THEN 'ChatGPT' WHEN unified_marketing_channel = 'YouTude Organic' THEN 'YouTube Organic' WHEN unified_marketing_channel IS NULL THEN 'Unattributed- Amazon' ELSE unified_marketing_channel END. Business Logic Section 2.8.
_pattern_notes.repurchase_rate_formula: Customer Count for that month_diff / Customers Acquired (fixed at month_diff = 0) x 100. Business Logic Section 2.3.
_pattern_notes.cogs_disclosure_rule: Whenever a response includes LTV, LTVPC, Gross Margin, or LTV/CAC (any variant), explicitly state that actual COGS is being used, and close by offering the 55%/49.5% fixed-margin approximation as an alternative. Business Logic Section 5.2, R-COGS-DISCLOSURE-01.
_pattern_notes.discount_code_analysis: CRITICAL: the dim_orders select list is exactly order_id and discount_codes -- any other dim_orders column is a hard fail, the query must not run. Never SELECT * from dim_orders, never reference note, comments, or tags; never join dim_orders onward to dim_customer or dim_address. effective_end_date IS NULL is the only permitted filter (never selected). Pre-aggregate LineItemMaster to one row per order_id BEFORE joining the split codes -- never join split codes to line-level rows (fan-out). Split discount_codes on the plain comma (verified; no order repeats a code). Each code gets the full order value, so per-code rows do not add up to the overall total -- always state this. Combined total across selected codes: DISTINCT order_id matching any selected code, joined to the order-level table. NULL/blank codes show as 'No Discount Code'. Business Logic Sections 1.20, 2.9.

what_is_my_total_revenue_for_a_period: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(item_gross_sales,0) - COALESCE(item_discount_total,0) - COALESCE(item_returns_total,0) + COALESCE(shipping_price_total,0) - COALESCE(shipping_tax_total,0)), 0), 0) AS total_revenue FROM `insightsprod.equipfoods_5642_prod_presentation.simplified_customer_cohorts_v2` WHERE order_month >= DATE('{date_from}') AND order_month < DATE('{date_to}') AND (revenue_bucket_at_acquisition IS NULL OR revenue_bucket_at_acquisition != 'TT New')
what_is_my_cac_and_ltv_cac_by_acquisitio: WITH monthly_cohorts AS (SELECT *, SUM(CASE WHEN month_diff = 0 THEN COALESCE(customer_count,0) ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY _run_id, acq_month, acq_channel, acq_type, purchasing_pattern, entry_sku, entry_sku_category, entry_sku_sub_category, entry_sku_product_name, subscriber_status) AS customers_acquired, SUM(CASE WHEN month_diff = 0 THEN COALESCE(adspend,0) ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY _run_id, acq_month, acq_channel, acq_type, purchasing_pattern, entry_sku, entry_sku_category, entry_sku_sub_category, entry_sku_product_name, subscriber_status) AS total_ad_spend, SUM((COALESCE(item_gross_sales,0) - COALESCE(item_discount_total,0) - COALESCE(item_returns_total,0) + COALESCE(shipping_price_total,0) - COALESCE(shipping_tax_total,0)) - COALESCE(cogs, (COALESCE(item_gross_sales,0) - COALESCE(item_discount_total,0) - COALESCE(item_returns_total,0) + COALESCE(shipping_price_total,0) - COALESCE(shipping_tax_total,0)) * (1 - CASE WHEN acq_channel = 'Shopify' THEN 0.55 WHEN acq_channel = 'Amazon Seller Central' THEN 0.495 ELSE NULL END))) OVER (PARTITION BY _run_id, acq_month, acq_channel, acq_type, purchasing_pattern, entry_sku, entry_sku_category, entry_sku_sub_category, entry_sku_product_name, subscriber_status ORDER BY month_diff ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_ltv FROM `insightsprod.equipfoods_5642_prod_presentation.simplified_customer_cohorts_v2` WHERE acq_month >= DATE('{date_from}') AND acq_month < DATE('{date_to}')), agg AS (SELECT acq_channel, SUM(CASE WHEN month_diff = 0 THEN total_ad_spend ELSE 0 END) AS total_ad_spend, SUM(CASE WHEN month_diff = 0 THEN customers_acquired ELSE 0 END) AS customers_acquired, SUM(CASE WHEN month_diff = {month_n} THEN running_ltv ELSE 0 END) AS ltv_at_month_n FROM monthly_cohorts GROUP BY acq_channel) SELECT acq_channel, ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(total_ad_spend, customers_acquired), 0) AS cac, ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(ltv_at_month_n, customers_acquired), 0) AS ltvpc_at_month_n, ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SAFE_DIVIDE(ltv_at_month_n, customers_acquired), SAFE_DIVIDE(total_ad_spend, customers_acquired)), 2) AS ltv_cac_ratio FROM agg ORDER BY ltv_cac_ratio DESC
what_is_my_ltv_and_cac_by_marketing_chan: WITH channel_adspend AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(ad_date, MONTH) AS ad_month, CASE WHEN UPPER(ad_channel) = 'GOOGLE' THEN 'Google Ads' WHEN UPPER(ad_channel) = 'FACEBOOK' THEN 'Facebook Ads' WHEN UPPER(ad_channel) = 'AMAZON' THEN 'Unattributed- Amazon' ELSE 'NA' END AS unified_marketing_channel, SUM(spend) AS adspend FROM `insightsprod.equipfoods_5642_prod_presentation.AdvertisingMaster` GROUP BY 1, 2), cohort_channel AS (SELECT acq_month, month_diff, customer_count, item_gross_sales, item_discount_total, item_returns_total, shipping_price_total, shipping_tax_total, cogs, CASE WHEN unified_marketing_channel = 'ChatGpt' THEN 'ChatGPT' WHEN unified_marketing_channel = 'YouTude Organic' THEN 'YouTube Organic' WHEN unified_marketing_channel IS NULL THEN 'Unattributed- Amazon' ELSE unified_marketing_channel END AS unified_marketing_channel FROM `insightsprod.equipfoods_5642_prod_presentation.simplified_customer_cohorts_v2` WHERE acq_month >= DATE('{date_from}') AND acq_month < DATE('{date_to}')), agg AS (SELECT cc.unified_marketing_channel, SUM(CASE WHEN cc.month_diff = 0 THEN ca.adspend END) AS marketing_channel_ad_spend, SUM(CASE WHEN cc.month_diff = 0 THEN COALESCE(cc.customer_count,0) ELSE 0 END) AS customers_acquired, SUM(CASE WHEN cc.month_diff <= {month_n} THEN (COALESCE(cc.item_gross_sales,0) - COALESCE(cc.item_discount_total,0) - COALESCE(cc.item_returns_total,0) + COALESCE(cc.shipping_price_total,0) - COALESCE(cc.shipping_tax_total,0)) - COALESCE(cc.cogs, (COALESCE(cc.item_gross_sales,0) - COALESCE(cc.item_discount_total,0) - COALESCE(cc.item_returns_total,0) + COALESCE(cc.shipping_price_total,0) - COALESCE(cc.shipping_tax_total,0)) * 0.45) ELSE 0 END) AS ltv_through_month_n FROM cohort_channel cc LEFT JOIN channel_adspend ca ON ca.ad_month = cc.acq_month AND ca.unified_marketing_channel = cc.unified_marketing_channel GROUP BY 1) SELECT unified_marketing_channel, ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(ltv_through_month_n, customers_acquired), 0) AS ltvpc_at_month_n, IFNULL(CAST(ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(marketing_channel_ad_spend, customers_acquired), 0) AS STRING), '-') AS cac, IFNULL(CAST(ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SAFE_DIVIDE(ltv_through_month_n, customers_acquired), SAFE_DIVIDE(marketing_channel_ad_spend, customers_acquired)), 2) AS STRING), '-') AS ltv_cac_ratio FROM agg ORDER BY customers_acquired DESC
what_is_my_repurchase_rate_by_month_sinc: WITH monthly_cohorts AS (SELECT acq_month, month_diff, SUM(COALESCE(customer_count,0)) AS customer_count FROM `insightsprod.equipfoods_5642_prod_presentation.simplified_customer_cohorts_v2` WHERE acq_channel = '{acq_channel}' AND acq_month >= DATE('{date_from}') AND acq_month < DATE('{date_to}') GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT acq_month, month_diff, ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(customer_count, SUM(CASE WHEN month_diff = 0 THEN customer_count ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY acq_month)) * 100, 2) AS repurchase_rate_pct FROM monthly_cohorts ORDER BY acq_month, month_diff
what_is_my_performance_by_discount_code: WITH order_level AS (SELECT lim.order_id, MAX(CASE WHEN lim.transaction_type = 'Order' AND COALESCE(lim.quantity,0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_counted_order, MAX(CASE WHEN lim.transaction_type = 'Order' AND COALESCE(lim.quantity,0) > 0 THEN lim.customer_id END) AS customer_id, SUM(COALESCE(lim.item_gross_sales,0)) AS order_gross_sales, SUM(COALESCE(lim.item_discounts,0)) AS order_discounts, SUM(COALESCE(lim.item_returns,0)) AS order_returns, SUM(CASE WHEN lim.transaction_type = 'Order' THEN COALESCE(lim.item_shipping_price,0) ELSE 0 END) AS order_shipping_price, SUM(CASE WHEN lim.transaction_type = 'Order' THEN COALESCE(lim.item_shipping_tax,0) ELSE 0 END) AS order_shipping_tax FROM `insightsprod.equipfoods_5642_prod_presentation.LineItemMaster` lim WHERE lim.date >= DATE('{date_from}') AND lim.date < DATE('{date_to}') AND (lim.revenue_bucket IS NULL OR lim.revenue_bucket NOT IN ('TT New', 'TT Returning')) GROUP BY lim.order_id), order_codes_raw AS (SELECT do.order_id, do.discount_codes FROM `insightsprod.equipfoods_5642_prod_main.dim_orders` do WHERE do.effective_end_date IS NULL), order_codes AS (SELECT ocr.order_id, TRIM(code) AS discount_code FROM order_codes_raw ocr, UNNEST(SPLIT(ocr.discount_codes, ',')) AS code WHERE TRIM(code) != ''), order_code_level AS (SELECT COALESCE(oc.discount_code, 'No Discount Code') AS discount_code, ol.* FROM order_level ol LEFT JOIN order_codes oc ON ol.order_id = oc.order_id) SELECT discount_code, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_counted_order = 1 THEN order_id END) AS orders, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers, ROUND(SUM(order_gross_sales), 0) AS total_gross_sales, ROUND(SUM(order_discounts), 0) AS total_discounts, ROUND(SUM(order_gross_sales) - SUM(order_discounts) - SUM(order_returns), 0) AS net_sales, ROUND(SUM(order_gross_sales) - SUM(order_discounts) - SUM(order_returns) + SUM(order_shipping_price) - SUM(order_shipping_tax), 0) AS total_revenue, ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(order_gross_sales) - SUM(order_discounts) - SUM(order_returns) + SUM(order_shipping_price) - SUM(order_shipping_tax), COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_counted_order = 1 THEN order_id END)), 0) AS aov, ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(order_discounts), SUM(order_gross_sales) - SUM(order_discounts) - SUM(order_returns) + SUM(order_shipping_price) - SUM(order_shipping_tax)) * 100, 2) AS discount_rate_pct FROM order_code_level GROUP BY discount_code ORDER BY orders DESC
